description.value: La Pache Pizza is a Neapolitan-influenced pizza counter on West Broadway offering a broad menu of Italian-style pies made with fior di latte and fresh toppings. The shop operates primarily as a takeout and online-order business, with a dedicated vegan pizza lineup alongside classic meat and vegetable options. West Broadway is a major cycling corridor in Vancouver, making this a convenient hot-food stop for riders passing through the Fairview and Kitsilano neighbourhoods.
